description: UniProt N-terminal call instability across orthologs and residue-level conservation of the AADACL2 N-terminal segment
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def search(q):
    f="accession,gene_names,organism_name,sequence,ft_signal,ft_transmem"
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?query={q}&fields={f}&format=json",timeout=300)
    j=r.json()
    if "results" not in j: print("API said:",str(j)[:300]); return []
    return j["results"]
kd={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,
    'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
summary=[]; ntermsets={}
for gene in ["AADACL2","AADAC","NCEH1","AADACL3","AADACL4"]:
    res=search(f"(gene:{gene})+AND+(taxonomy_id:7742)")
    keep=[]
    for e in res:
        sq=e["sequence"]["value"]
        gn=(e.get("genes") or [{}])[0].get("geneName",{}).get("value","").upper()
        if gn!=gene or not (350<=len(sq)<=460): continue
        keep.append(e)
    calls=collections.Counter(); ntv=[]
    for e in keep:
        sq=e["sequence"]["value"]
        sig=[f for f in e.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Signal"]
        tm =[f for f in e.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Transmembrane"]
        calls["SIGNAL" if sig else ("TRANSMEM" if tm else "none")]+=1
        h=max([np.mean([kd.get(a,0) for a in sq[i:i+11]]) for i in range(2,16)])
        if sq[0]=="M" and h>1.5 and len(sq)>=26: ntv.append(sq[:26])
    ntermsets[gene]=ntv
    b=100*np.mean([any(a in "KR" for a in s[:6]) for s in ntv]) if ntv else np.nan
    summary.append(dict(gene=gene,orthologs=len(keep),aligned_Nterm=len(ntv),
                        SIGNAL=calls["SIGNAL"],TRANSMEM=calls["TRANSMEM"],no_call=calls["none"],
                        pct_basic_res1_6=round(b,1)))
S=pd.DataFrame(summary); print("UniProt N-terminal feature calls across vertebrate orthologs\n"); print(S.to_string(index=False))
S.to_csv("uniprot_Nterm_call_instability.csv",index=False)

v=ntermsets["AADACL2"]; print(f"\nAADACL2 orthologs with aligned hydrophobic N-terminus: n={len(v)}")
cons=[]
for i in range(26):
    c=collections.Counter(s[i] for s in v); top,ct=c.most_common(1)[0]
    cons.append((i+1,top,100*ct/len(v)))
print("  ".join(f"{p}{r}:{f:.0f}%" for p,r,f in cons))
print("\nnet charge res1-6 (AADACL2 orthologs):",dict(collections.Counter(sum(1 for a in s[:6] if a in 'KR')-sum(1 for a in s[:6] if a in 'DE') for s in v)))
print("residue at pos4:",dict(collections.Counter(s[3] for s in v)))
print("residue at pos18 (= P1 if SIGNAL 1-18):",dict(collections.Counter(s[17] for s in v)))
print("AADAC orthologs res2-4:",collections.Counter(s[1:4] for s in ntermsets['AADAC']).most_common(8))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,4.8))
xs=np.arange(1,27)
ax[0].bar(xs,[f for _,_,f in cons],color=["#d1495b" if p==4 else "#3a7ca5" for p,_,_ in cons])
for p,r,f in cons: ax[0].text(p,f+1.5,r,ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax[0].set_xlabel("residue position"); ax[0].set_ylabel("% of orthologs carrying the modal residue")
ax[0].set_title("AADACL2 N-terminus: residue-level conservation\nin %d vertebrate orthologs (Lys4 red)"%len(v),fontsize=10); ax[0].set_ylim(0,114)
w=np.array([[np.mean([kd.get(a,0) for a in s[max(0,i-3):i+4]]) for i in range(26)] for s in v])
wa=np.array([[np.mean([kd.get(a,0) for a in s[max(0,i-3):i+4]]) for i in range(26)] for s in ntermsets["AADAC"]])
ax[1].plot(xs,w.mean(0),color="#d1495b",lw=2,label="AADACL2 orthologs (n=%d)"%len(v))
ax[1].fill_between(xs,w.mean(0)-w.std(0),w.mean(0)+w.std(0),color="#d1495b",alpha=.2)
ax[1].plot(xs,wa.mean(0),color="#3a7ca5",lw=2,label="AADAC orthologs (n=%d)"%len(ntermsets["AADAC"]))
ax[1].fill_between(xs,wa.mean(0)-wa.std(0),wa.mean(0)+wa.std(0),color="#3a7ca5",alpha=.15)
ax[1].axhline(0,color="k",lw=.6); ax[1].axvline(18.5,color="orange",ls="--",lw=2)
ax[1].text(18.8,-1.8,"UniProt SIGNAL 1-18\nproposed cleavage (P1 = His)",fontsize=7.5,color="darkorange")
ax[1].set_xlabel("residue position"); ax[1].set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy (window 7)")
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8); ax[1].set_title("Hydrophobic segment spans the proposed cleavage site",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
